data.title: 阿蕾克希亚 · 放学街角的可丽饼投喂
data.description: 放学后的静谧商业小巷中，夕阳将青石地面染成温暖的橙黄。阿蕾克希亚双手捧着刚出炉的草莓奶油可丽饼，微红着脸颊把最甜的一侧递向少年，语气傲娇却满眼宠溺。
data.location: cozy cobblestone academy town street corner at dusk
data.action: leaning forward slightly, holding up a strawberry whipped cream crepe with both hands offering a bite, blushing cheeks, adorable pouting smile
data.lighting: golden sunset backlighting framing silver hair with warm streetlamp glow
data.mood: playful tsundere date, sweet afterschool romance, innocent youthful affection
data.promptProse: On a cobblestone academy street corner at sunset, Alexia Midgar offers a bite of her strawberry cream crepe, blushing adorably with a fond tsundere pout.
data.animaCaption: Offering a bite of strawberry crepe on the sunset cobblestone street, she pouts with an adorable flustered blush.
